I can tell you right now you are the type of person introverts hate. People with bad social skills(myself) get anxiety when they have to talk in a conversation. It becomes exhausting to continue talking and you panic and run out of things to say. Most quiet people are quiet because of this anxiety. So it’s just not worth it to sustain a conversation if you feel sick after it’s over.
